m: Chips: oven to 220°C. Cut potatoes into chips, toss with oil and salt, roast 35 to 40 minutes, turning once.
Special sauce: mayo, tomato sauce, mustard and a spoonful of chopped pickles.
Roll the mince into 110g balls (two per person). Slice the onion paper thin.
Get a heavy pan or BBQ plate smoking hot. Add a ball, smash it flat with a spatula, season hard. Cook 2 minutes until the edge is deep brown.
Flip, add a cheese slice, cook 1 minute more. Stack two patties per burger.
Toast the buns. Sauce, lettuce, double patty, pickles, onion. Done.
l: Burger bowl: patties over shredded lettuce and leftover rice or chips, sauce in a little container.
g: GF buns, toasted separately. Cook the GF patties first on a clean surface. Check the mustard and pickle labels.
